primary_intent_authority: WHITEPAPER.md principles plus current accepted strategic decisions
primary_behavior_evidence: End-to-end product surfaces and use cases at the pinned commits
verification_evidence: Scenario review and human design-authority approval
authority_rule: Whitepaper may establish thesis but cannot establish shipped status
conflict_disposition: Record C or V gap and submit a decision packet

primary_behavior_evidence: grammar/contextql.lark and parser behavior at the pinned core commit
authority_rule: Accepted decision outranks specification prose; grammar proves accepted input only
conflict_disposition: Record C or V gap; do not infer semantics from grammar

primary_intent_authority: SPEC.md plus current accepted DECISIONS.md entries
primary_behavior_evidence: Semantic models, validation, lowerer, executor, and DDL runtime at the pinned core commit
verification_evidence: Semantic, integration, negative, and conformance tests
authority_rule: Implementation demonstrates behavior but cannot supersede accepted intent silently
conflict_disposition: Record V, I, S, or T gap and prepare a decision packet when intent conflicts

primary_intent_authority: Current accepted API decisions and published API documentation
primary_behavior_evidence: Exported symbols, signatures, and callable behavior at the pinned core commit
verification_evidence: Contract, compatibility, example, and negative tests
authority_rule: Exports prove surface presence only; documentation cannot prove callable behavior
conflict_disposition: Record D, P, V, or T gap

primary_intent_authority: Current accepted API/version decisions and published server documentation
primary_behavior_evidence: FastAPI routes, request/response models, and OpenAPI output at the pinned server commit
verification_evidence: HTTP integration, error, authorization, persistence, and compatibility tests
authority_rule: Routes and models prove surface presence only; public behavior includes failure contracts
conflict_disposition: Record D, P, V, I, or T gap

primary_intent_authority: Current storage/lifecycle decisions and applicable normative specification
primary_behavior_evidence: Migrations, repositories, services, transitions, and startup restoration at the pinned commits
verification_evidence: Restart, migration, transition, recovery, and failure tests
authority_rule: In-memory or happy-path behavior is not proof of durable lifecycle support
conflict_disposition: Record P, V, I, S, or T gap; escalate state-model conflicts

primary_intent_authority: Current protocol, failure-policy, and identity decisions
primary_behavior_evidence: Provider contracts, connectors, broker paths, and identity maps at the pinned commits
verification_evidence: Contract, timeout, mismatch, boundedness, partial-failure, and cross-system tests
authority_rule: Mocks and extension points are partial evidence and not proof of federation maturity
conflict_disposition: Record P, V, I, S, or T gap

primary_intent_authority: Current security decisions, threat model, and explicit policy requirements
primary_behavior_evidence: Authorization enforcement, tenant boundaries, credential handling, storage controls, and audit implementation
verification_evidence: Abuse cases, authorization tests, tenant-isolation tests, audit-integrity evidence, and security review
authority_rule: Security prose or audit-event models do not prove enforcement
conflict_disposition: Record P0/P1 gap and require human adjudication before weakening a claim

primary_intent_authority: Explicitly scoped approved claim or benchmark requirement
primary_behavior_evidence: Benchmark code, data generator, engine configuration, and bounded runtime path at the pinned commit
verification_evidence: Reproducible raw benchmark artifact with correctness checks and complete environment metadata
authority_rule: A benchmark script or anecdotal run does not support a published claim
conflict_disposition: Record T or V gap; narrow or remove unsupported claim

primary_intent_authority: METHODOLOGY.md M0–M6 rules and current accepted release criteria
primary_behavior_evidence: Reachable integrated behavior across the relevant pinned layers
verification_evidence: Tests, public probes, restart/failure evidence, operational data, and independent review appropriate to the level
authority_rule: Maturity is the minimum level supported across required layers, not the strongest isolated artifact
conflict_disposition: Relabel maturity and record P or T gap

primary_intent_authority: Approved roadmap or current accepted decision
primary_behavior_evidence: Prototype code may be supporting evidence only
verification_evidence: Exit criteria, experiment results, or validated problem evidence
authority_rule: Proposal, TODO, branch, presentation, or historical plan is not an approved commitment
conflict_disposition: Record R or U; route through feature intake and human decision

primary_intent_authority: Current accepted intent plus the capability register
primary_behavior_evidence: Pinned implementation reached through the documented public surface
verification_evidence: Executable example or focused conformance test
authority_rule: Documentation is evidence of a claim, not evidence that the claim is true
conflict_disposition: Record D, C, V, or T gap

primary_intent_authority: Immutable Git commit and repository history
primary_behavior_evidence: Diff, blame, tag, and commit metadata
authority_rule: History explains when or where a change occurred; it never decides intended semantics
conflict_disposition: Use as provenance only and escalate substantive conflict to the applicable authority
